items.title: Replace hallway light fitting
items.body: The fitting outside room 4 flickers. MARKER-BODY-01 swap it for the spare in the store cupboard.

items.title: Order printer paper and toner
items.body: Two boxes of plain white. MARKER-BODY-02 deliver to the front desk.

items.title: Fix squeaking door hinge
items.body: Kitchen door, top hinge. MARKER-BODY-03 a drop of oil should do.

items.title: Update the visitor sign-in sheet
items.body: Add a column for car registration and one for the host's name. MARKER-BODY-04B print thirty copies.

items.title: Book the meeting room for Friday
items.body: Ten people, two hours after lunch. MARKER-BODY-05 projector needed.

items.title: Clear the gutter above the side entrance
items.body: Leaves are blocking it. MARKER-BODY-06 ladder is in the shed.

items.title: Renew the fire extinguisher check
items.body: Annual check is due this month. MARKER-BODY-07 four extinguishers in total.

items.title: Label the shelves in the store cupboard
items.body: Shelf names agreed last week. MARKER-BODY-08 use the label printer.

items.title: Replace the kettle
items.body: The old one trips the fuse. MARKER-BODY-09 budget is small.

items.title: Tidy the notice board
items.body: Remove notices older than a month. MARKER-BODY-10 keep the fire plan.
